evidence: Carries the Wallet label and modifies external signer PSBT handling in src/external_signer.cpp and test/functional/wallet_signer.py.
rationale: Core previously trusted external signer responses wholesale, leaving users vulnerable to output tampering, fee diversion, or unsafe sighash flags by buggy signers or compromised intermediate bridge software. Merging PSBTs instead of replacing them and rejecting unsafe signatures protects against unauthorized output alterations and theft.
